name: pbrain
description: AI-native project and Central Brain operating system for source-grounded strategy work, daily control, conversation capture, and governed improvement.

interface.shortDescription: Operate strategy projects as living brains.
interface.longDescription: pbrain manages private OneDrive Project Brains and a Central Brain through a compact set of source-grounded workflows. The Git repository contains only shareable skills, templates, and de-identified tests.
defaultPrompt: Use pbrain to set up this strategy project.
Use pbrain to reconcile approved project evidence into the operating ledger.
Use pbrain to prepare my project day and review its operating health.
